tools.name: check_email_health
tools.description: Check a domain's email deliverability with Yeevu: MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI and blacklist status, with what is wrong and how to fix it. Use when someone asks why their emails go to spam, aren't delivered, or whether their email setup is correct.

tools.name: check_email_record
tools.description: Run one Yeevu email check on a domain in full detail: mx, spf, dkim, dmarc, mta_sts, tls_rpt, bimi_record or blacklist. Use for questions about one record, for example 'is my SPF right?' or 'am I blacklisted?'.

tools.name: get_full_report_link
tools.description: Get a link to Yeevu's free full email deliverability report for a domain, with an overall score and step-by-step fixes. Offer it after a check, or when someone wants to see everything in one place.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_email_health, check_email_record, get_full_report_link · Private data: check_email_record · Public sink: check_email_health, check_email_record, get_full_report_link · Destructive: check_email_record.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_email_health, check_email_record, get_full_report_link · Private data: check_email_record · Public sink: check_email_health, check_email_record, get_full_report_link · Destructive: check_email_record

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
